_comment: Destination-level text for /plumber/ohio. originShared applies to every origin row; merged from the records' own wording with the origin made generic. Quotation marks only around text verbatim in the named registered source.

originShared.text: OCILB's published Plumbing agreements are with Arkansas, Mississippi, and West Virginia. Ohio's state Plumbing license is a contractor license for commercial work, issued by the Ohio Construction Industry Licensing Board (OCILB) and tied to a "contracting company" (OCILB's Out of State Examination Application). Document your out-of-state license held for at least 5 years (for example, a letter of good standing); at least five building permits issued under that license; at least one tax return showing income earned under it (plus one W-2 if not an owner); and that your contracting company is registered in Ohio as a foreign corporation or foreign LLC with a designated in-state agent. Whether your license is substantially similar to Ohio's Plumbing contractor license is OCILB's case-by-case judgment; Ohio law does not define the standard.
